title: Software Engineering Intern
description: Assist senior engineers in building and maintaining software applications. Work on real features, write unit tests, and participate in code reviews under mentorship.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description: Develop and maintain software features with guidance from senior developers. Expected to debug issues independently and contribute to Agile sprint cycles.

title: Software Engineer
description: Design, develop, and ship production-grade software features. Collaborate cross-functionally with product and QA teams to deliver high-quality, well-tested code.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Lead technical design for complex features, mentor junior engineers, and drive best practices across the engineering team. Own end-to-end delivery of critical system components.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description: Define architectural direction across multiple product teams and serve as the technical lead for high-impact initiatives. Drive engineering culture and cross-team technical strategy.

title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
description: Build and maintain native iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI. Collaborate with designers to create performant, accessible, and delightful mobile experiences.

title: Embedded Systems Engineer
description: Develop low-level firmware and embedded software for microcontroller-based products. Optimize code for resource-constrained environments and perform hardware-software integration testing.

title: Game Developer
description: Design and implement gameplay systems, physics, and rendering pipelines using Unity or Unreal Engine. Work with artists and designers to build immersive interactive experiences.

title: Firmware Engineer
description: Write, test, and maintain firmware for hardware products including IoT devices and consumer electronics. Coordinate closely with hardware engineers during bring-up and validation phases.

title: Platform Engineer
description: Build and maintain internal developer platforms, tooling, and frameworks that improve engineering productivity. Define standards for how services are built, deployed, and monitored.

title: React Frontend Developer
description: Develop responsive, accessible web applications using React and its ecosystem. Translate Figma designs into pixel-perfect, performant UI components.

title: Angular Frontend Developer
description: Build enterprise-grade single-page applications using Angular and RxJS. Implement complex state management, routing, and integration with RESTful and GraphQL APIs.

title: Vue.js Frontend Developer
description: Build dynamic user interfaces using Vue 3 and the Composition API. Collaborate with backend teams to integrate APIs and ensure smooth user experiences.

title: Node.js Backend Developer
description: Design and build scalable REST and GraphQL APIs using Node.js and Express. Own the backend services that power both web and mobile client applications.

title: Django Backend Developer
description: Build robust Python web services and REST APIs using Django and Django REST Framework. Work with PostgreSQL and implement authentication, caching, and task queues.

title: Spring Boot Backend Developer
description: Develop and maintain Java microservices using Spring Boot and Spring Cloud. Design RESTful APIs and integrate with relational databases and messaging systems.

title: Ruby on Rails Backend Developer
description: Build convention-driven web applications and APIs using Ruby on Rails. Maintain high test coverage and optimize ActiveRecord queries for large datasets.

title: GraphQL API Developer
description: Design and implement GraphQL schemas, resolvers, and subscriptions for real-time applications. Optimize query performance and enforce schema-first API contracts.

title: Full-Stack Developer (MERN)
description: Develop end-to-end web applications using the MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js stack. Own features from database schema design to responsive UI implementation.

title: Mobile-First Full-Stack Developer
description: Build cross-platform mobile applications using React Native with a Node.js or Firebase backend. Ensure seamless offline support and responsive design across devices.

title: Jamstack Developer
description: Build fast, secure, and scalable web applications using Jamstack principles with Next.js or Gatsby. Integrate headless CMSs and third-party APIs to deliver content-rich experiences.

title: Backend for Frontend (BFF) Engineer
description: Design and maintain Backend-for-Frontend layers that aggregate microservices for specific client needs. Optimize API contracts, implement caching, and ensure resilient service-to-service communication.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Build, train, and deploy machine learning models for production use cases. Partner with data scientists to productionize experiments and maintain ML pipelines.

title: Data Scientist
description: Analyze complex datasets to extract actionable business insights and build predictive models. Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: NLP Engineer
description: Design and deploy natural language processing pipelines for tasks including text classification, NER, summarization, and sentiment analysis. Fine-tune transformer models for domain-specific applications.

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Develop computer vision models for image classification, object detection, and segmentation. Optimize inference pipelines for real-time and edge deployment.

title: MLOps Engineer
description: Build and maintain ML infrastructure including model training pipelines, experiment tracking, model registries, and deployment workflows. Bridge the gap between data science and production engineering.

title: Data Analyst
description: Query, clean, and visualize data to support business decision-making. Build dashboards and reports that track key performance indicators across product and operations.

title: AI Research Scientist
description: Conduct original research in machine learning, publish findings, and prototype novel algorithms. Translate cutting-edge research into practical improvements for product ML systems.

title: Deep Learning Engineer
description: Design and optimize deep neural networks for large-scale production applications. Work with GPU clusters to accelerate training and conduct ablation studies to improve model performance.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description: Build applications powered by large language models and multimodal generative AI systems. Design prompt engineering strategies, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows.

title: LLM Fine-tuning Engineer
description: Specialize in fine-tuning large language models using techniques like LoRA, RLHF, and instruction tuning. Evaluate model quality and manage datasets for domain adaptation.

title: Analytics Engineer
description: Build and maintain clean, well-tested data models in the analytics layer using dbt. Bridge the gap between raw data engineering and business analytics by owning semantic data models.

title: BI Developer
description: Design and develop business intelligence dashboards and reports using Power BI or Tableau. Translate complex business requirements into clear, interactive data visualizations.

title: AWS Cloud Engineer
description: Design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure on Amazon Web Services. Implement cost-effective architectures using EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and VPC components.

title: GCP Cloud Engineer
description: Build and manage scalable cloud workloads on Google Cloud Platform. Work with GKE, BigQuery, Cloud Run, and Pub/Sub to deliver reliable, cloud-native solutions.

title: Azure Cloud Engineer
description: Architect and operate Azure cloud environments for enterprise workloads. Manage Azure VMs, AKS, Azure DevOps pipelines, and Azure Active Directory integrations.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automate infrastructure provisioning, and improve deployment reliability and velocity. Champion DevOps culture across engineering teams.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Define and enforce SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets to ensure production system reliability. Lead incident response, conduct post-mortems, and reduce toil through automation.

title: Platform Engineer (Cloud)
description: Build internal cloud platforms and self-service tooling that enable development teams to deploy faster. Own the developer experience layer including golden path templates and service catalogs.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description: Provision and maintain cloud and on-premises infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code tools. Manage networking, storage, and compute resources for production workloads.

title: Kubernetes Specialist
description: Design and operate large-scale Kubernetes clusters, including custom operators, admission controllers, and multi-cluster federation. Optimize workload scheduling, resource management, and cluster security.

title: Cloud Architect
description: Define cloud architecture strategy and govern infrastructure standards across the organization. Evaluate technology options and design multi-region, highly available solutions.

title: FinOps Engineer
description: Optimize cloud spending by analyzing usage data, rightsizing resources, and implementing cost governance policies. Work with engineering and finance teams to drive cloud financial accountability.

title: Security Analyst
description: Monitor security alerts, investigate potential threats, and perform vulnerability assessments. Contribute to incident response procedures and help maintain the security posture of the organization.

title: Penetration Tester
description: Conduct authorized offensive security assessments against web applications, networks, and cloud environments. Produce detailed vulnerability reports with prioritized remediation recommendations.

title: Application Security Engineer
description: Integrate security into the SDLC by performing threat modeling, secure code reviews, and SAST/DAST scanning. Educate developers on secure coding practices and champion security-by-design.

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description: Secure cloud infrastructure by implementing IAM policies, network segmentation, encryption, and compliance controls. Continuously audit cloud posture using CSPM tools.

title: SOC Analyst
description: Provide first and second line monitoring and analysis of security events from SIEM platforms. Triage alerts, escalate confirmed incidents, and document findings for the security team.

title: Security Engineer
description: Design and build security systems, authentication frameworks, and detection infrastructure at scale. Partner with platform and product teams to enforce security architecture across all services.

title: QA Engineer
description: Design and execute test cases for web and backend applications to ensure product quality. Work closely with developers to identify defects early in the development cycle.

title: SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test)
description: Build scalable test automation frameworks for UI, API, and integration testing. Contribute to CI pipelines by integrating automated test suites and maintaining flakiness dashboards.

title: Performance Test Engineer
description: Design and execute load, stress, and endurance tests to validate system performance under realistic and peak conditions. Identify bottlenecks and work with engineering teams on resolution.

title: Mobile QA Engineer
description: Validate mobile app quality on iOS and Android through manual and automated testing. Use Appium or Espresso to build device-farm automated regression suites.

title: API Test Engineer
description: Specialize in testing REST and GraphQL APIs using contract testing, schema validation, and automated regression suites. Ensure API quality, backward compatibility, and reliability.

title: Test Architect
description: Define the test strategy, tooling, and quality frameworks across all engineering teams. Set standards for test coverage, flakiness thresholds, and shift-left quality practices.

title: Product Manager
description: Define product vision, roadmap, and strategy by synthesizing customer needs, market data, and business goals. Work cross-functionally to prioritize and ship features that drive key outcomes.

title: Business Analyst
description: Elicit, document, and analyze business requirements to guide technology solutions. Bridge communication between business stakeholders and development teams throughout the project lifecycle.

title: Technical Product Manager
description: Drive product strategy for technically complex platform and infrastructure products. Partner closely with engineering leads to define APIs, data contracts, and platform capabilities.

title: Scrum Master
description: Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, remove impediments, and coach teams on Agile principles to maximize delivery effectiveness. Track team velocity and continuously improve sprint processes.

title: Product Owner
description: Own and prioritize the product backlog to maximize value delivered by the development team. Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and collaborate with stakeholders to refine the roadmap.

title: Solutions Architect
description: Design end-to-end technical solutions aligned with business requirements and enterprise architecture standards. Engage with clients and stakeholders to propose system designs and technology selections.

title: Enterprise Architect
description: Define technology strategy and architectural governance at the enterprise level. Align IT capabilities with business strategy across multiple business units and long-term technology roadmaps.

title: IT Business Analyst
description: Support IT projects by gathering and documenting requirements, assisting with UAT, and liaising between technical teams and business users. Maintain project documentation and track change requests.

title: Digital Product Manager
description: Lead the ideation, development, and optimization of digital products including web apps and mobile experiences. Use analytics and user research to drive data-informed product decisions.

title: IT Support Specialist
description: Provide first and second line technical support to end users across hardware, software, and connectivity issues. Manage tickets using an ITSM platform and escalate complex issues to senior staff.

title: System Administrator
description: Manage and maintain on-premises and cloud servers, ensuring uptime, security patching, and performance monitoring. Administer user accounts, group policies, and system backups.

title: Network Engineer
description: Design, implement, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure including LAN, WAN, and SD-WAN environments. Troubleshoot complex Layer 2/3 routing and switching issues.

title: Database Administrator
description: Install, configure, and maintain relational database systems, ensuring high availability, performance, and data integrity. Design backup strategies and optimize slow queries for production databases.

title: IT Project Manager
description: Plan and deliver IT projects on time and within budget using PMI or Agile methodologies. Coordinate vendors, manage risks, and communicate project status to executive stakeholders.

title: Help Desk Technician
description: Respond to end-user support requests via phone, email, and chat. Resolve common hardware and software issues, reset credentials, and document all interactions in the ticketing system.

title: Storage Engineer
description: Design and manage enterprise storage solutions including SAN, NAS, and cloud object storage. Ensure data availability, disaster recovery readiness, and storage performance optimization.

title: Virtualization Engineer
description: Administer VMware vSphere or Hyper-V environments, managing VM provisioning, resource allocation, and cluster health. Plan and execute VM migrations, upgrades, and capacity planning.

title: IT Auditor
description: Assess IT controls, policies, and procedures to ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks like ISO 27001, SOC 2, and GDPR. Document findings and work with IT teams on remediation plans.

title: ERP Specialist
description: Configure, maintain, and support ERP platforms such as SAP or Oracle for finance, HR, and supply chain modules. Gather requirements from business users and translate them into system configurations.

title: Registered Nurse
description: Provide direct patient care, monitor health conditions, administer treatments, maintain clinical records, and coordinate with physicians and care teams in hospitals or community settings.

title: Medical Assistant
description: Support clinical teams by preparing patients, recording vital signs, assisting with examinations, scheduling appointments, and maintaining accurate medical records.

title: Clinical Research Coordinator
description: Coordinate clinical studies, recruit participants, maintain study documentation, support informed consent, and help ensure research activities follow approved protocols and regulations.

title: Physical Therapist
description: Evaluate movement and physical function, create individualized rehabilitation plans, deliver therapeutic interventions, and document progress toward patient goals.

title: Pharmacist
description: Review prescriptions, dispense medications safely, counsel patients on medication use, identify interactions, and collaborate with healthcare providers on treatment plans.

title: Medical Laboratory Scientist
description: Perform diagnostic laboratory tests, validate results, maintain instruments and quality controls, and communicate findings that support clinical diagnosis and treatment.

title: Elementary School Teacher
description: Plan and deliver age-appropriate lessons, assess student learning, manage a supportive classroom, communicate with families, and adapt instruction to varied learning needs.

title: Secondary School Teacher
description: Teach subject-area content to secondary students, design assessments, support classroom engagement, track progress, and collaborate with families and school colleagues.

title: Special Education Teacher
description: Develop and deliver individualized instruction, monitor student progress, coordinate accommodations, and partner with families and multidisciplinary support teams.

title: Instructional Designer
description: Design learning experiences and course materials, analyze learner needs, collaborate with subject experts, and evaluate training effectiveness across digital or classroom programs.

title: Accountant
description: Maintain financial records, reconcile accounts, prepare statements, support month-end close, and help ensure transactions follow accounting standards and internal controls.

title: Financial Analyst
description: Analyze financial performance, prepare forecasts and budgets, build decision-support models, and explain financial trends to business leaders.

title: Internal Auditor
description: Assess financial and operational controls, test compliance with policies, document audit evidence, identify risks, and recommend practical corrective actions.

title: Loan Officer
description: Review loan applications, assess borrower information and repayment capacity, explain lending options, and coordinate documentation through the approval process.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description: Plan and optimize digital campaigns across search, social, email, and web channels; track performance; and use audience insights to improve reach and conversion.

title: Content Marketing Specialist
description: Create and manage useful content that supports brand awareness and customer education, coordinating editorial calendars and reviewing engagement performance.

title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
description: Improve organic search visibility through keyword research, technical site reviews, on-page optimization, content recommendations, and performance reporting.

title: Market Research Analyst
description: Research customers, competitors, and market conditions; analyze qualitative and quantitative findings; and communicate evidence-based recommendations to stakeholders.

title: Sales Development Representative
description: Identify potential customers, conduct respectful outreach, qualify business needs, maintain prospect records, and schedule discovery conversations for sales teams.

title: Account Executive
description: Manage prospective customer relationships from discovery through negotiation and close, understand business needs, present suitable solutions, and maintain accurate forecasts.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Help customers achieve intended outcomes, coordinate onboarding, monitor account health, resolve adoption barriers, and communicate renewal or expansion opportunities.

title: Human Resources Generalist
description: Support employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, records, policies, benefits coordination, employee relations, and compliance with workplace requirements.

title: Recruiter
description: Coordinate hiring with managers, source and screen candidates, conduct structured interviews, maintain applicant records, and provide clear communication throughout selection.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description: Analyze inventory, procurement, logistics, and supplier performance; identify operational risks; and recommend improvements to cost, service, and delivery performance.

title: Project Coordinator
description: Coordinate schedules, meeting notes, task tracking, status reports, and stakeholder communication to help teams deliver projects on time and within scope.

title: Operations Manager
description: Oversee day-to-day operations, improve service and process performance, manage resources, and coordinate teams to meet quality, safety, and business objectives.

title: Electrician
description: Install, inspect, maintain, and repair electrical wiring and equipment while following applicable codes, safety procedures, diagrams, and job specifications.

title: HVAC Technician
description: Install, inspect, diagnose, and repair heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration systems in residential or commercial settings.

title: Plumber
description: Install, maintain, and repair water supply, drainage, and plumbing systems; diagnose leaks and blockages; and ensure work follows plans and local codes.

title: Construction Project Manager
description: Plan construction project scope, schedules, budgets, subcontractor coordination, safety practices, and quality reviews from preconstruction through handover.

title: Civil Engineering Technician
description: Support civil engineering projects through site surveys, materials testing, technical drawings, field inspections, and documentation of construction activities.

title: Social Worker
description: Assess client needs, provide case management and referrals, support access to community resources, maintain confidential records, and advocate for client well-being.

title: Public Policy Analyst
description: Research policy issues, analyze legislation and program data, assess impacts, prepare briefings, and communicate evidence-based options to public-sector decision makers.

title: Community Health Worker
description: Connect community members with health and social services, provide culturally responsive health information, support care navigation, and document outreach activities.

title: Environmental Scientist
description: Collect and analyze environmental samples, assess impacts to air, water, and land, prepare technical reports, and support compliance and remediation projects.

title: Laboratory Research Technician
description: Prepare samples, conduct laboratory procedures, operate and maintain research equipment, record results, and follow quality and safety protocols.

title: Agricultural Scientist
description: Study crops, soils, pests, and agricultural systems; conduct field and laboratory research; and advise on practices that improve productivity and sustainability.

title: Hotel Operations Manager
description: Coordinate front desk, housekeeping, guest services, staffing, and service quality to ensure smooth daily hotel operations and positive guest experiences.

title: Chef
description: Prepare and present menu items, coordinate kitchen operations, maintain food quality and safety, manage ingredients, and support consistent service during busy periods.

title: Event Planner
description: Plan events from requirements gathering through delivery, coordinating venues, vendors, schedules, budgets, guest communications, and on-site logistics.

title: Paralegal
description: Support legal professionals through case research, document preparation, filing coordination, evidence organization, and clear communication with clients and courts.

title: Compliance Officer
description: Monitor adherence to laws, regulations, and internal policies; assess compliance risks; conduct reviews; maintain records; and coordinate remediation and staff guidance.
